about-school.label: About — about the school
about-school.title: The Indiranagar Cambridge School
about-school.body:
The Indiranagar Cambridge School, established in 1979, is a co-educational institution located in the lush surroundings of HAL 3rd Stage, Bengaluru. Managed by the Indiranagar Cambridge Educational Trust, with Late Mrs. Kasturi Shoury as the Founder Managing Trustee, the school offers education from Nursery through Grade 10, adhering to the Karnataka State Education Board (KSEEB) curriculum. The medium of instruction is English, with Kannada as the second language and Hindi as the third.

The school emphasizes a balanced blend of experienced and dynamic faculty, fostering continuous innovation to enhance educational quality. Beyond academics, it offers a range of extracurricular activities, including life skills classes, meditation sessions, spell bee competitions, and educational cinema through Edumedia. The curriculum is enriched with programs like Gaptopedia, newspaper-in-education initiatives, health education via Address Health, field trips, and student counselling services.

Facilities at The Indiranagar Cambridge School include well-equipped classrooms, libraries, science and computer laboratories, and a spacious playground accommodating sports like cricket, tennis, basketball, karate, and athletics.

Located at #52, 6th Cross, 8th Main Road, HAL 3rd Stage, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, The Indiranagar Cambridge School continues its legacy of providing quality education, focusing on the holistic development of its students.

about-founder.label: About — the founder
about-founder.title: Founder Trustee
about-founder.body:
Late Mrs. Kasturi Shoury, the visionary founder trustee of Indiranagar Cambridge School, was a woman of unwavering determination and profound foresight. Born on May 7, 1950 in Tamil Nadu and raised in Mangalore, her journey led her to Bangalore after her marriage to Mr. K.M. Shoury.

Mrs. Shoury firmly believed that having small aspirations in life was a disservice to one's potential. While working with the Department of Post & Telegraph, she recognized her calling—to make a meaningful contribution to society through education. Determined to provide quality English-medium education to the lower middle class, she founded Indiranagar Cambridge School in 1979.

With just seven students and two teachers, she began the school in a modest rented space in Thippasandra. Balancing her night shifts at the Department of P&T, her responsibilities as a school founder during the day, and her role as a loving mother to three sons, Mrs. Shoury epitomized dedication and perseverance.

Her relentless efforts bore fruit year after year, with the school expanding steadily. In 1986, the institution moved to its current premises, and by 1989, the first batch of Class X students graduated.

Mrs. Shoury was a beacon of energy, resilience, and generosity, always extending a helping hand to those in need. She never sought competition with others but instead believed in continuous self-improvement. Though she is no longer with us, her legacy lives on through the institution she built with passion and purpose. Indiranagar Cambridge School stands tall as a testament to her vision, carrying forward her dream of empowering young minds through education.

about-principal.label: About — the principal
about-principal.title: Principal's Desk
about-principal.subtitle: Principal · M.Phil, MA, B.Ed
about-principal.body:
To create a compassionate, inclusive school environment where every child is seen, valued, and supported.

We strive to foster a love of learning, ensuring that each student, regardless of their financial background or academic ability, is empowered to grow, thrive, and achieve their personal best.

Our school is a place where passion for education meets care and understanding, nurturing well-groomed individuals who are prepared for the future.

Education serves as the foundation for knowledge and the pursuit of truth—it is the one constant in our lives. It plays a crucial role in the holistic development of an individual, equipping them with the skills needed to navigate life's challenges. For a young child, school provides a structured yet nurturing environment that mirrors the real world, offering invaluable learning experiences.

At Indiranagar Cambridge School, we are committed to preparing our students for life beyond the classroom. While we emphasize academic excellence in subjects like Mathematics, Sciences, and Languages, we also focus on developing emotional intelligence and social skills through various competitions, activities, and sports. We encourage critical and creative thinking while fostering curiosity, as we believe that true education goes beyond academics—it must nurture both the mind and the heart.

Our mission would be incomplete without the unwavering support of parents, who entrust us with the responsibility of guiding their children's growth. At ICS, our dedicated staff mentor students with care, kindness, and discipline, ensuring they are well-prepared to spread their wings and soar when they graduate.

As George Evans wisely said, "Every student can learn, just not on the same day or in the same way." We remain committed to helping each child reach their full potential in their own unique way.

info-safety.label: School information — safety & wellbeing
info-safety.title: Safety & Wellbeing
info-safety.body:
According to the Karnataka State Child Protection Policy 2016, every school has to create "A Child Safety Committee". The members of the committee are:

- The school head / school administrator (in the committee the school head is the school administration) – 1
- Two teachers – one must be a woman – 2
- Two children of SDMC (School Development & Monitoring Committee) – 2
- One officer or a staff member of the Health Department – 1

This meeting will be held monthly.

### Points of Discussion
- Children protection rights will be discussed, awareness created and close consultation done.
- Records will be maintained.
- The Directorate of Children has launched a toll free number 14499 to provide free self-counselling service for children.
- The children helpline number 1098 should be posted on the walls of the school.
- Complaint and suggestion boxes are placed in school at a height children can reach.
- To create awareness regarding the Child Protection Policy 2016, SOP and guidelines in parents' meetings, and to inform parents to bring directly to the attention of the school any problem related to the safety and rights of children.
- If there is any problem related to child safety violation, school / institution heads and departmental officers will take action based on the Child Protection Policy 2016 and SOP.
- Awareness of responsibilities of school / institute Head Master / Head Mistress and teaching staff.
- All departmental officers, teachers and staff should take necessary steps to ensure that no children drop out of school and are not deprived of education.
- All persons working on the school premises must have official identity cards, and complete records of these persons are kept in the school.
- Teachers / staff are present in the school half an hour before the scheduled school period, recording the attendance of children in the morning and afternoon and ensuring that the children are in the school.
- During the prescribed period, children are not sent out for any reason.
- The school timetable is provided to children and parents by school terms and class wise.
- Special classes – approval of parents is taken for the child to attend special classes.
- Head teachers are available when special classes are conducted. A subject teacher, a physical education teacher and one female teacher are physically present.
- The concerned teacher confirms with the parents the safe arrival of the children after the end of special classes.

### Other Safety Measures in the School
- There are two entries, i.e. student entry and entry for others.
- At the entries there are security personnel on duty 24/7. A visitors' log book is diligently maintained at the entries.
- There are 128 CCTV cameras installed in the school building covering the classrooms, corridors and common areas, all functional and monitored.
- Every floor has dedicated floor in-charges monitoring the activities of the students during school hours.
- A parent authentication card / walker's pass with the picture of the parents / guardians is issued to students. Parents / guardians are required to carry the card while visiting the school.
- Fire safety: 10 fire extinguishers are installed in the building (2 on each floor near the washrooms, 1 in the science laboratory and 1 in the computer lab). All extinguishers have been re-filled and the licence renewed.
- Generator maintenance: periodic servicing of the generator is done.
- 6 Blue Star water dispensers provide pure drinking water to the students.
- A traffic awareness session on road safety was conducted by traffic inspectors from Jeevanbhima Nagar Traffic Police Station, briefing students on rules, traffic signs and signals, accidents, road manners and important signage.

info-child-safety.label: School information — child safety (POCSO)
info-child-safety.title: Child Safety
info-child-safety.body:
To prevent sexual violence, harassment and abuse of children under the age of 18 years, and to provide protection, security and wellbeing to children, the Government of India has implemented the POCSO Act 2012.

### POCSO Rules (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act & Rules, 2012)
- The school strictly follows the POCSO rules. Special orientation has been given to the entire staff of the school.
- Procedures are followed for behavioural, bullying and academic issues; corporal punishment is not permitted in or out of classrooms.
- Teachers use positive discipline to develop the child's own self-discipline, to build a mutually respectful relationship with students and to teach them life-long skills.
- Age-appropriate safe touch and unsafe touch has been taught to all children in classrooms, and puberty sessions have been taken in groups.
- Laws that protect children and prosecute offenders include:
  - The Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act
  - National Policy for Children
  - The National Charter for Children (2003)

Children can call the Childline helpline 1098 at any time.

people.name: Mrs. Aruna Pradeep Kannan
people.bio:
Mrs. Aruna Pradeep Kannan is an experienced educationist and school leader with 20 years of professional experience, including a decade in the IT sector and over 10 years in education. She holds a Diploma in Computer Science Engineering (D.C.E.), B.E. in Information Science, and Nursery Teacher Training (N.T.T.), and is currently pursuing her B.Ed. from Bangalore University.

With a strong belief that education should nurture both academic excellence and emotional well-being, she is committed to creating a child-friendly, disciplined and dynamic learning environment. As Headmistress of The Indiranagar Cambridge School, she works towards empowering students to discover their potential, develop confidence and become responsible citizens of tomorrow.

Her educational philosophy is simple: every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed.

people.name: Tr. Pallavi
people.bio: Tr. Pallavi is a passionate Middle School Science Teacher with over 5 years of teaching experience and a Master's degree in Science Education. She specializes in making complex scientific concepts accessible, fun, and relevant to everyday life. Her interactive lessons focus on hands-on laboratory experiments, critical thinking, and collaborative projects, encouraging curiosity and active learning among students.

people.name: Tr. Sowmya S. Chandi
people.qual: M.A., B.A., B.Ed. in Hindi, N.T.T.
people.bio:
Tr. Sowmya S. Chandi is an experienced Hindi educator with over a decade of teaching experience across High School, Upper Primary and Pre-University levels. She has served as a Hindi Teacher and Lecturer at reputed institutions including Global P.U. College, Miranda English Medium School and Sree Cauvery School.

Her areas of expertise include Hindi language teaching, classroom management, storytelling and script writing. She also brings strong skills in leadership and problem-solving, along with a passion for music. A trained singer, she holds Gamaka Junior and Senior certifications.

Her commitment to language, creativity and holistic learning enables her to make Hindi education engaging and meaningful for students.

people.name: Tr. Shruthi H. C.
people.bio:
Mrs. Shruthi H. C. is a dedicated Kannada educator with 8 years of teaching experience and a strong passion for promoting the richness of the Kannada language. She encourages students to develop their skills in reading, writing and grammar while nurturing creativity and confidence.

She actively prepares students for Kannada language competitions, elocution, essay writing, storytelling and poetry activities. She also contributes to the academic development of students by creating worksheets, question papers, study materials and other learning resources.

Her involvement in school cultural programmes through Kannada speeches, poetry and anchoring reflects her enthusiasm for making language learning engaging, expressive and meaningful.

people.name: Tr. Meenakshi M.
people.bio:
Mrs. Meenakshi M. is an experienced Social Science educator with 30 years of teaching experience, with a strong commitment to academic excellence and effective classroom practices.

She has been honoured with the Active Teacher Award by Akhil Bharatiya Nagrik Vikas Kendra and has actively participated in the 321 Ignite Programme and ELN practical classroom teaching initiatives.

She received a Certificate for Exemplary Performance for the academic year 2016–17 at SCET School. With her rich experience and leadership abilities, she has also served as a Middle School and High School Coordinator, contributing to academic planning, teacher support and student development.

Her dedication, experience and leadership make her a valuable member of the academic team at The Indiranagar Cambridge School.

people.name: Mrs. Veena Raj
people.qual: B.A. Psychology, B.Ed. (EVS), N.T.T., Diploma in Fashion Technology; M.A. Psychology (pursuing)
people.bio:
Mrs. Veena Raj is a dedicated educator and student counsellor with experience in teaching, child psychology, counselling and behavioural therapy. She has worked across pre-primary, primary and secondary levels, teaching subjects including Social Science, EVS and Kannada.

Her expertise includes student counselling, behavioural therapy, classroom management, child psychology, art and craft, and dance. She has a special interest in supporting young learners and helping children navigate behavioural and emotional challenges.

Her compassionate approach and experience in working with early learners enable her to provide individualised guidance and counselling support, contributing to a safe, nurturing and positive learning environment at The Indiranagar Cambridge School.

people.name: Tr. Nirmala Vinoth
people.qual: M.Sc. IT, B.Ed., M.C.S., B.Sc. Mathematics
people.bio:
Mrs. Nirmala Vinoth is a dedicated Mathematics educator with experience in Middle School teaching and class management. She promotes a student-centred approach with emphasis on conceptual understanding, problem-solving and activity-based learning.

She actively integrates technology and innovative teaching methods to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.

Area of Expertise: Middle School Mathematics – Grades 7 & 8.

people.name: Tr. Jayalakshmi
people.bio: Tr. Jayalakshmi is an enthusiastic high school Kannada teacher with over 6 years of teaching experience, dedicated to cultivating a deep love for the language, literature and cultural heritage of Karnataka. She specialises in translating classical and modern Kannada literature into relatable concepts, helping students easily grasp complex poetry and prose.
